name: GTE Reranker ModernBERT
attention_variant: cross-encoder (ModernBERT), full bidirectional attention over query+passage with local+global attention pattern
notes: RERANKER: cross-encoder, kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0, KV formula does not apply. ModernBERT architecture (not BERT): hidden 768, 22 layers, 12 heads, intermediate 1152, vocab 50368, 8192 max_position_embeddings. Uses local attention (128 tokens) with global attention every 3 layers — this is the ModernBERT efficiency innovation. 149M params, much smaller than bge-reranker-large (578M) but with 8192 context vs 514. Apache-2.0. GGUF and ONNX ports exist.
